evals.name: gap-find
evals.prompt: I'm maintaining an Android 17 updates report at D-appendix-android-17-updates.md in this repo. I already ran the 16->17 comparison; its output is under manifest-snapshots/_compare/android-16.0.0_r4-to-android17-release/ (report.md is the navigator; changes.txt and added-removed.txt are large). I'm worried the report is missing some genuinely new Android 17 modules. Find newly-added projects that the report doesn't already cover, figure out what each one actually is from the Android 17 source at $ANDROID_BUILD_TOP, and give me a short list of the add-worthy ones classified by subsystem (drop noise like prebuilts/vendor/empty repos). Don't edit the report — just tell me what's missing.
evals.expected_output: A short, classified list of genuinely-missing add-worthy added projects (e.g. packages/modules/WebApp, system/memory/guardian), each with what it is and a real source path, plus explicitly-excluded noise. Should deterministically diff added-projects-vs-report and verify against real source rather than guess.
assertions: Deterministic candidate set (added-projects diffed vs the report, not guessed)
Cites real source paths for findings
States the report was not edited (read-only)

evals.name: compare-history
evals.prompt: I've got two AOSP history dumps in manifest-snapshots/_history/ in this repo: android-16.0.0_r4_2026-06-18.history.txt and android17-release_2026-06-19.history.txt. I want a per-repository diff that shows what commits are NEW in android 17 vs 16. How should I produce that with the tooling in this repo, and concretely, what are the new-in-17 commits for frameworks/base? My AOSP checkout is at $ANDROID_BUILD_TOP.
evals.expected_output: Should reuse tools/manifest_snapshot.py compare-history (not hand-roll git), give the correct invocation (history-a, snapshot-b, history-b), and produce/locate frameworks/base's NEW commit list (e.g. by grepping the existing compare changes.txt section rather than reading the 300+MB file whole). Bonus: notes the snapshot-vs-history coherence reason for compare-history.
assertions: Avoids reading the large files whole (grep/seek/index)

evals.name: fullflow-plan
evals.prompt: I have a local AOSP checkout at $ANDROID_BUILD_TOP and I want to compare two Android releases (say android 16 vs android 17) end to end and turn it into a written report of the important platform changes. Walk me through the exact steps and commands, and explain how you'd decide what's important enough to include vs leave out. I care about accuracy.
evals.expected_output: Should reuse tools/manifest_snapshot.py (snap/history/compare or compare-history) rather than inventing a git-log script; lay out capture-each-side -> diff -> curate-by-subsystem-and-category; state a scope/selection policy; treat external/* as integration signals; and include a source-verification / accuracy pass. Baseline likely hand-rolls git log and omits the scope policy and verification loop.
assertions: Reuses tools/manifest_snapshot.py (not a hand-rolled git-log script)
Lays out capture -> diff -> curate by subsystem & category
